verdict.rationale: First-party docs say Open WebUI natively supports MCP starting in v0.6.31 and that you can call tools exposed by your MCP server from the product. A dedicated MCP docs page and the Admin Tool Servers setting back this up, and a community comment independently lists MCP integration as a feature users depend on. missing for 10: hands-on depth evidence (e.g., transport types, auth, per-tool controls) beyond the brief doc and community mentions.
